newsitem.title: USA: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE AT STANDSTILL - USDA.
newsitem.headline: TEXAS/W OKLA FED CATTLE TRADE AT STANDSTILL - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers. The last established market was $64.00 on Friday, Monday's packer bids were $63.00-$64.00, with asking prices mostly $66.00. There were 8,600 head sold week to date. Confirmed - None Last Week - None Year Ago - 200
Wk to date - 8,600 Last Week - 26,600 Year Ago - 23,400
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
